parameters.query: select * from public.inbound_messages where kind = 'photo' and status = 'pending_ocr' and storage_path is not null order by received_at limit 1;

update public.inbound_messages
set status = 'processing', claimed_at = now(), processing_attempts = processing_attempts + 1, last_processing_attempt_at = now()
where id = $1 and status = 'pending_ocr'
returning *;
select folder_code from public.events where id = $1;
update public.inbound_messages set status = $1, error = $2, processed_at = now() where id = $3 returning id, status;
update public.inbound_messages set status = 'failed', error = $1, error_class = $2 where id = $3 returning id;
update public.inbound_messages set status = 'failed', error = $1, error_class = 'terminal' where id = $2 returning id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ 'event ' + $('Claim Photo Message').item.json.event_id + ' has no folder_code', $('Claim Photo Message').item.json.id ] }}

parameters.content:
## pipeline-process-cards-sms
The n8n replacement for local-agent/agent.mjs photoLoop -- the SMS-photo intake path, now the SOLE card-photo intake path since watcher/ is retired outright (per the plan's 'Decisions locked in'). reconcile_retryable_failed_inbound_messages is deliberately NOT called here -- Stage 0's pipeline-retry-failed-inbound-messages already covers it on its own cadence, decoupled from this pipeline's, since that RPC is not kind-specific (covers audio and photo alike).

Find Pending Photo + Claim Photo Message mirror findNextPendingPhotoMessage/claimPhotoMessage exactly (plain SELECT then a single atomic UPDATE ... WHERE status=pending_ocr RETURNING *).

All the actual vision/crop work lives in sub-process-cards (built alongside this pipeline) -- this workflow's own job is thin: claim, resolve the event's folder_code (required by contacts-from-ocr, absent from the SMS message itself), delegate, then fan the returned cards out to sub-post-cards-to-ocr one at a time and aggregate.

Has Folder Code? is a defensive check for a case processPhotoMessage treats as a thrown error (event has no folder_code) -- kept as an explicit early branch here rather than letting a missing field surface as a confusing failure three nodes later.

Classify Error reuses the exact same TERMINAL_ERROR_PATTERNS classifyProcessingError applies to the photo path today -- notably the literal string 'no legible business card detected in photo' that sub-process-cards's Return No Card Detected node emits on purpose, so a genuinely card-less photo classifies as terminal (never auto-retried, surfaced via the existing Retry OCR action) exactly as it does now.

Aggregate Post Results mirrors processPhotoMessage's own allFailed logic: a photo where SOME cards posted successfully stays 'completed' with the failures recorded in error (the contacts that did land are already real and visible in Review) -- only a photo where NOTHING could be created is 'failed'.

INACTIVE / BUILD-ONLY (n8n migration Stage 4). No credential of its own -- both Execute Workflow calls delegate to sub-workflows that hold the actual credentials (sub-process-cards: Anthropic + Storage; sub-post-cards-to-ocr: Supabase Service Role). See n8n/README.md.
